```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Objective
The objective of this model is to isolate the mucosa in fragments of small intestine,
and classify them based on orientation and artefact.

This is a rule-based model where the parameters were set by trying different values and inspecting
resulting polygons in QuPath

## Parameters
- *min_area_1000_um*: Small intestinal mucosa polygons under this size are filtered out before being assigned names, default is 100 (100,000 um2)
- *high_conf_lim*: Mucosal layers under this confidence levels are not considered when classifying
mucosa polygons as small intestinal mucosa or not (but are still used for outlining the small intestinal mucosal polygons, and for calculating percentages). Default is 100 %.
- *orientation_adequate_th*: The percentages of villi, crypts, portion of circumference of villi or crypts overlapping with the circumference of the others needs all to be above this to be considered adequate. Default is 30 %.
- *orientation_marginal_th*: The percentages of villi, crypts, portion of circumference of villi or crypts overlapping with the circumference of the others needs all to be above this (but not all to be above the adequate th to be considered marginal. If any is under it is inadequate.  Default is 10%.
- *artefact_adequate_th*
Default 95
- *artefact_marginal_th* 
Default 70


## Input
- *subset_<subset>.json* (fe_si_images/process_subset/output/process_subset/)
- *fragments_metadata_<subset>.json* (fe_si_images/fragments/output/fragments/)
- *included_fragments_<subset>.json* (fe_si_images/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/)
- *<image>_fragments.geojson* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/)
- *<image>_<fragment>_<model_version>_layers.geojson* (fe_si_models/combos/output/map_to_fragments/)
- *<image>_<fragment>_<model_version>_.geojson* (fe_si_models/combos/output/map_to_fragments/)

## Output
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_<mucosa_name>_mucosa.geojson* (fe_si_models/mucosa/output/mucosa/)
- *mucosa_metadata_<subset>.json*
- *mucosa_metadata.json*
For all processed fragments

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = "0") #Allows processing of large files

read_sf_retry <- function(path, retries = 3, wait = 5) {
  attempt <- 1
  while (attempt <= retries) {
    msg <- sprintf("  ↳ trying to open %s (attempt %d/%d)…", basename(path),
                   attempt, retries)
    cat(msg, "\n")

    x <- tryCatch(
      st_read(path, quiet = TRUE) |> st_set_crs(0),
      error = function(e) NULL            # swallow the error, return NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(x)) return(x)            # success → return the object

    Sys.sleep(wait)                       # wait a bit and try again
    attempt <- attempt + 1
  }
  stop("failed")                          # let caller know it never worked
}

process_mucosa <- function(model_version,
                           subset, 
                           fragment_metadata, 
                           fragment_dir, 
                           map_to_fragment_dir, 
                           mucosa_dir, 
                           min_area_1000_um2 = 500,
                           high_conf_limit = 100,
                           orientation_adequate_th = 30,
                           orientation_marginal_th = 10,
                           artefact_adequate_th = 95,
                           artefact_marginal_th = 70
                           ){
  
  checkpoint_file <- file.path(mucosa_dir, "subset_mucosa_metadata_checkpoint.rds")
  
  log_meta <- function(df){               # df is st_drop_geometry(mucosa)
    subset_mucosa_metadata <<- dplyr::bind_rows(subset_mucosa_metadata, df)
    saveRDS(subset_mucosa_metadata, checkpoint_file)  # instant disk backup
  }

  image_names <- unique(fragment_metadata$image_name)
  image_fragment_names <- unique(fragment_metadata$image_fragment_name)
  
  subset_mucosa_metadata <-
  if (file.exists(checkpoint_file)) readRDS(checkpoint_file) else NULL
  
  for (image_fragment in image_fragment_names){
    tryCatch({
      image_fragment_fragment_metadata <- fragment_metadata %>% 
        filter(image_fragment_name == image_fragment)
      
      img <- image_fragment_fragment_metadata$image_name
      frag <- image_fragment_fragment_metadata$fragment_name
      
      image_metadata <- subset %>% filter(image_name == img)
      pixel_area_um2 <- image_metadata$pixel_area_um2
      pixel_length_um <- image_metadata$pixel_length_um
      
      #Read in and process layers 
      layer_path <- paste0(map_to_fragment_dir, image_fragment, "_", model_version, "_layers.geojson")
      layers <- read_sf_retry(layer_path) %>% st_set_crs(0)
      
      #Handle cases with no layers (no recognized villi or crypts of any confidence)
      
      if (nrow(layers) == 0) {
        fragment_path <- paste0(fragment_dir, img, "_fragments.geojson")
        mucosa <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
          st_set_crs(0) %>%
          filter(name == frag) %>%
          rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
          mutate(mucosa_name = "00",
                 name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_"),
                 classification = "no_mucosa",
                 orientation_class = NA,
                 artefact_class = NA,
                 area_1000_um2 = fragment_area_um2 / 1000,
                 villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                 crypts_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                 pct_villi = 0,
                 pct_crypts = 0,
                 pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                 pct_shared_border_crypts = NA,
                 quality_villi_1000_um2 = NA,
                 quality_crypts_1000_um2 = NA,
                 quality_pct_villi = NA,
                 quality_pct_crypts = NA) %>%
          select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, orientation_class, artefact_class, area_1000_um2, villi_area_1000_um2, crypts_area_1000_um2, pct_villi, pct_crypts, pct_shared_border_villi, pct_shared_border_crypts, quality_villi_1000_um2, quality_crypts_1000_um2, quality_pct_villi, quality_pct_crypts, geometry)
        
         st_write(mucosa, paste0(mucosa_dir, mucosa$name, "_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
         
          log_meta(st_drop_geometry(mucosa))
          
          next
      }
      
       #Unite classes in compartments (epithelium, lamina propria and lumen to identify areas of ok quality)
      
      #Unite the different layers to si_mucosa polygons (may vary in number per fragment)
      mucosa_draft <- layers %>%
        group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked) %>%
        summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
        st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(classification = "mucosa",
               area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
               area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
               area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000) %>%
        filter(area_1000_um2 > min_area_1000_um2) %>%
        mutate(mucosa_name = str_pad(rank(-area_px2, ties.method = "first"), width = 2, pad = "0"),
               name = paste(img, frag, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
        select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2) %>%
        arrange(name)
      
      #Layers of all confidence levels are used for calculating percentages used for orientation
      layers_all_conf_united <- layers %>%
        group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked, classification) %>%
        summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")
      
      villi <- layers_all_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "villi")
      crypts <- layers_all_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "crypts")
      
      compartments_path <- paste0(map_to_fragment_dir, image_fragment, "_", model_version, "_compartments.geojson")
      
      compartments <- read_sf_retry(compartments_path) %>% st_set_crs(0)
      
      #Process by individual mucosa polygons within fragments
      
       for (muc_part in mucosa_draft$mucosa_name) {
         tryCatch({
         
           mucosa_part <- mucosa_draft %>% filter(mucosa_name == muc_part)
           mucosa_geom <- mucosa_part %>% select(name, geometry)
           
           villi_all_conf <- st_intersection(villi, mucosa_geom) %>%
              st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>% 
             group_by(classification, name) %>%       
             summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
             st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>%
             mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
                    area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
                    area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
                    circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
            
           crypts_all_conf <- st_intersection(crypts, mucosa_geom) %>%
             st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>% 
             group_by(classification, name) %>%       
             summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
             st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>%
             mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
                    area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
                    area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
                    circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
            
            #Classify orientation
            if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0) {
            mucosa <- mucosa_part %>%
              mutate(classification = "no_mucosa",
                     orientation_class = NA,
                     villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                     crypts_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                     pct_villi = 0, pct_crypts = 0,
                     pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                     pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
            } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0) {
            mucosa <- mucosa_part %>%
              mutate(orientation_class= "inadequate",
                     villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                     crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                     pct_villi = 0, pct_crypts = 100,
                     pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                     pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
            } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0) {
            mucosa <- mucosa_part %>%
              mutate(orientation_class = "inadequate",
                     villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                     crypts_area_1000_um2 =0,
                     pct_villi = 100, pct_crypts = 0,
                     pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                     pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
            } else {
            shared_border <- st_intersection(st_boundary(villi_all_conf), st_boundary(crypts_all_conf))
            
            shared_len <- st_length(shared_border)
            
            villi_part <- villi_all_conf %>%
              mutate(pct_shared_border = (shared_len / circumference_px) * 100)
            
            crypts_part <- crypts_all_conf %>%
              mutate(pct_shared_border = (shared_len / circumference_px) * 100)
            
            mucosa <- mucosa_part %>%
              mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                     crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                     pct_villi = (villi_area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
                     pct_crypts = (crypts_area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
                     pct_shared_border_villi = villi_part$pct_shared_border,
                     pct_shared_border_crypts = crypts_part$pct_shared_border,
                     orientation_class = case_when(
                       pct_villi > orientation_adequate_th & pct_crypts > orientation_adequate_th &
                         pct_shared_border_villi > orientation_adequate_th & pct_shared_border_crypts > orientation_adequate_th ~ "adequate",
                       pct_villi > orientation_marginal_th & pct_crypts > orientation_marginal_th &
                         pct_shared_border_villi > orientation_marginal_th & pct_shared_border_crypts > orientation_marginal_th ~ "marginal",
                       pct_villi <= orientation_marginal_th | pct_crypts <= orientation_marginal_th |
                         pct_shared_border_villi <= orientation_marginal_th | pct_shared_border_crypts <= orientation_marginal_th ~ "inadequate",
                       TRUE ~ NA_character_
                     ))
            }
            
            if (nrow(compartments) == 0) {
              mucosa <- mucosa %>%
                mutate(artefact_class = "inadequate",
                       quality_villi_1000_um2 = 0,
                       quality_crypts_1000_um2 = 0,
                       quality_pct_villi = NA,
                       quality_pct_crypts = NA,
                       classification = paste(classification, "orientation", orientation_class, "artefact", artefact_class, sep = "_")) %>%
                select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, orientation_class, artefact_class, area_1000_um2, villi_area_1000_um2, crypts_area_1000_um2, pct_villi, pct_crypts, pct_shared_border_villi, pct_shared_border_crypts, quality_villi_1000_um2, quality_crypts_1000_um2, quality_pct_villi, quality_pct_crypts, geometry)
          
           st_write(mucosa, paste0(mucosa_dir, mucosa$name, "_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
           
            log_meta(st_drop_geometry(mucosa))
            
            next
        }
            
            compartments_united  <- compartments %>%
              group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked) %>%
              summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
              mutate(classification = "quality_tissue")
            
            
            
            #Classify orientation
            villi_geom <- villi_all_conf%>% select(name, geometry)
            crypts_geom <- crypts_all_conf %>% select(name, geometry)
            
            quality_villi <- st_intersection(compartments_united, villi_geom) %>%
               st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>% 
              group_by(classification, name) %>%
               summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
               st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>%
               mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
                      area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
                      area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000)
            
            quality_crypts <- st_intersection(compartments_united, crypts_geom) %>%
               st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>% 
              group_by(classification, name) %>%
               summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
               st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>% 
               mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
                      area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
                      area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000)
             
            if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0) {
               mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_pct_villi = NA,
                        quality_pct_crypts = NA,
                        artefact_class = NA)
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) == 0 ) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_pct_villi = NA,
                        quality_pct_crypts = NA,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) == !0 ) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = quality_crypts$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_pct_villi = NA,
                        quality_pct_crypts = (quality_crypts_1000_um2 / crypts_area_1000_um2) * 100,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) == 0 ) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_pct_villi = NA,
                        quality_pct_crypts = NA,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) != 0 ) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = quality_villi$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = NA,
                        quality_pct_villi = (quality_villi_1000_um2 / villi_area_1000_um2) * 100,
                        quality_pct_crypts = NA,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
                 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) == 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) == 0) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_pct_villi = 0,
                        quality_pct_crypts = 0,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) == 0) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = quality_villi$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_pct_villi = (quality_villi_1000_um2 / villi_area_1000_um2) * 100,
                        quality_pct_crypts = 0,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
                 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) == 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) != 0) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = 0,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = quality_crypts$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_pct_villi = NA,
                        quality_pct_crypts = (quality_crypts_1000_um2 / crypts_area_1000_um2) * 100,
                        artefact_class = "inadequate"
                        ) 
               } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_villi) != 0 && 
                          nrow(quality_crypts) != 0) {
                 mucosa <- mucosa  %>%
                 mutate(villi_area_1000_um2 = villi_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        crypts_area_1000_um2 = crypts_all_conf$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_villi_1000_um2 = quality_villi$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_crypts_1000_um2 = quality_crypts$area_1000_um2,
                        quality_pct_villi = (quality_villi_1000_um2 / villi_area_1000_um2) * 100,
                        quality_pct_crypts = (quality_crypts_1000_um2 / crypts_area_1000_um2) * 100) %>%
                   mutate(artefact_class = case_when(
                     quality_pct_crypts > artefact_adequate_th  & quality_pct_villi > artefact_adequate_th ~ "adequate",
                     quality_pct_crypts > artefact_marginal_th & quality_pct_villi > artefact_marginal_th ~ "marginal",
                     quality_pct_crypts <= artefact_marginal_th | quality_pct_villi <= artefact_marginal_th ~ "inadequate",
                     TRUE ~ NA_character_))
               }
                 
             
             mucosa <- mucosa %>%
               mutate(classification = paste(classification, "orientation", orientation_class, "artefact", artefact_class, sep = "_")) %>%
               select(image_name, 
                      fragment_name, 
                      mucosa_name, 
                      name, 
                      classification, 
                      orientation_class, 
                      artefact_class, 
                      area_1000_um2, 
                      villi_area_1000_um2, 
                      crypts_area_1000_um2, 
                      pct_villi, pct_crypts, 
                      pct_shared_border_villi, 
                      pct_shared_border_crypts, 
                      quality_villi_1000_um2, 
                      quality_crypts_1000_um2, 
                      quality_pct_villi, 
                      quality_pct_crypts, geometry)
             
            
            st_write(mucosa, paste0(mucosa_dir, mucosa$name, "_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
            
            log_meta(st_drop_geometry(mucosa))
          
         }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("Error processing mucosa part %s in image fragment %s: %s", 
                          muc_part, image_fragment, e$message))
          # Optionally: log to a file
          cat(sprintf("ERROR: %s - %s\n", muc_part, e$message), 
              file = paste0(mucosa_dir, "mucosa_processing_errors.txt"), append = TRUE)
          # Skip to next muc_part
        })
       }
      }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Error processing image fragment %s: %s", image_fragment, e$message))
    cat(sprintf("ERROR: %s - %s\n", image_fragment, e$message), 
        file = paste0(mucosa_dir, "mucosa_processing_errors.txt"), append = TRUE)
    # Skip to next image_fragment
      })
  }
  
  
  
  return(subset_mucosa_metadata)
}



```




#### Process grading_sample (batch_0) (fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution/)
The min area size was set to 100 for this but filtered afterwards to 500


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

subset_name <- "grading_sample"
model_version <- "fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2"

included_fragments <- fromJSON(paste0("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/fragments_included_", subset_name, ".json")) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"))

image_fragment_names <- unique(included_fragments$image_fragment_name)
image_names <- unique(included_fragments$image_name)

subset <- fromJSON(paste0("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_", subset_name, ".json")) %>%
  filter(image_name %in% included_fragments$image_name)

fragment_metadata <- fromJSON(paste0("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/fragment_metadata_", subset_name,".json")) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_")) %>%
  filter(image_fragment_name %in% included_fragments$image_fragment_name)

fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/"

map_to_fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_fragment/output/map_to_fragment/"

mucosa_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/"



#Check that all images have downloaded and processed layer files
map_to_fragment_files <- list.files(map_to_fragment_dir)
matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[
  sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) any(startsWith(map_to_fragment_files, name)))
  ]

non_matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[
  !sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) any(startsWith(map_to_fragment_files, name)))
]


min_area_1000_um2 <- 100
high_conf_limit <- 100
```
